title: feat(layout): P1.7 Navigation Enhancements — search, pin favorites, drag reorder
body:
Completes P1.7 Console Navigation Enhancements. Items 1–2 (AppSchema renderer, area switcher) were already shipped in P0.1; this PR adds items 3–4.

### NavigationRenderer — new opt-in props

- **`searchQuery`** — recursive case-insensitive label filter across the navigation tree. Groups kept if any child matches; separators stripped during search. Utility `filterNavigationItems()` exported for external use.
- **`enablePinning` + `onPinToggle`** — pin/unpin action button on each leaf item. Pinned items collected into a "Favorites" section at the top of the sidebar.
- **`enableReorder` + `onReorder`** — `@dnd-kit/sortable` vertical list reorder with grip handles, 5px activation distance, drag opacity feedback. Reordered items emitted with updated `order` indices.

### AppSchemaRenderer — search input wiring

- `enableSearch` adds a `SidebarInput` in the sidebar header; query state managed internally and passed to `NavigationRenderer`.
- `enablePinning`, `onPinToggle`, `enableReorder`, `onReorder` forwarded through `InternalSidebar`.

### Usage

```tsx
<AppSchemaRenderer
  schema={appJson}
  basePath="/apps/crm"
  enableSearch
  enablePinning
  onPinToggle={(id, pinned) => updateUserPrefs(id, pinned)}
  enableReorder
  onReorder={(items) => saveNavOrder(items)}
>
  <Outlet />
</AppSchemaRenderer>
```

All features are additive/opt-in — zero breaking changes. 33 new tests (71 total), all passing. `@dnd-kit` versions match existing usage in `plugin-kanban`. ROADMAP updated.
